els.text: Where the campaign landed against its goals

deck.name: Phân tích Chiến dịch Tiếp thị

name: Phân tích Chiến dịch Tiếp thị · Trang 4

els.text: The campaign extended visibility across existing and new audience segments, with the widest gains coming from channels that hadn’t been prioritized in previous cycles.
Audiences interacted more consistently with campaign content than in prior runs, suggesting the messaging resonated beyond the initial click.
Engagement translated into a meaningful lift in qualified activity, though conversion still trails reach, pointing to a gap worth closing in the next cycle.

deck.name: Phân tích Chiến dịch Tiếp thị

name: Phân tích Chiến dịch Tiếp thị · Trang 5

els.text: This lift came primarily from mid-funnel engagement, where prospects moved from initial interest to a direct inquiry more often than in past campaigns.
Increase in qualified leads versus the previous quarter

els.text: The campaign built strong interest but needs tighter follow-through to convert it. Faster sales follow-up, a smoother product handoff, and consistent messaging should close that gap.

deck.name: Phân tích Chiến dịch Tiếp thị

name: Phân tích Chiến dịch Tiếp thị · Trang 11

els.text: The next campaign cycle should start with the same cross-team visibility this report aims to create. Shared context earlier in the process should help each team act on findings sooner rather than after the fact.
